title: PHP 7.4 to 8.2 upgrade: a pre-flight audit checklist
lede: You said yes to the PHP 8.2 jump on a ten-year-old WordPress install. Before the maintenance window opens, here is the audit that keeps it boring.
hero_alt: Overhead photo: graph-paper PHP upgrade checklist, printed function sheets, manila AUDIT folder, brass PRE-FLIGHT plate, fountain pen.
